CHN.note: World's dominant offal IMPORT market. UN Comtrade 2024: imports 1,191 kt of edible offal (HS0206) — top suppliers USA 318, Spain 232, Canada 122, Netherlands 117, Denmark 116, France 76. Swing buyer for global pork/beef/poultry organ meats. Production not separately measured (offal is a slaughter by-product); cons~prod+imports.

USA.note: Largest single offal EXPORTER by value/volume. UN Comtrade 2024: exports 736 kt (HS0206) — top markets China 288, Mexico 219, Japan 43, Egypt 38, Philippines 38. Recorded imports 897 kt under HS0206 include large cross-border/re-import lines (Mexico, Canada); net trade balance is approximate. Offal is a high-value-recovery by-product of US beef/pork/poultry slaughter.

ESP.note: Major EU offal exporter (pork-heavy). Comtrade/FAOSTAT 2024: large flows to China 232, Philippines 108, France 31, Sweden 27, Italy 17 — world's #2 China supplier. Export total ~360 kt (modeled from observed flows; prod is a slaughter by-product).

DEU.note: Leading EU pork-offal exporter/processor. UN Comtrade 2024 exports ~290 kt (HS0206); intra-EU flows to Netherlands 115, Belgium 62, Denmark 28, plus West Africa (Cote d'Ivoire). Major slaughter hub; offal a by-product of carcass business.

NLD.note: EU trade/processing hub. Exports offal to China 117, Belgium 50, Philippines 30, Germany 15 and re-imports German offal (DEU->NLD 115). Export total ~250 kt modeled from observed flows.

BRA.note: Major beef/poultry offal exporter. 2024 flows to Hong Kong 153, Cote d'Ivoire 42, China 22, Philippines 21, Egypt 18. Export total ~330 kt modeled from observed flows; offal is a side-stream of Brazil's large carcass-meat export business.

CAN.note: Significant offal exporter. 2024 flows to China 122, USA 43, Mexico 43, Philippines 24. Export ~230 kt modeled from observed flows.

DNK.note: Pork-offal exporter (Danish Crown side-stream). 2024 flows to China 116, Germany 20. Export ~165 kt modeled from observed flows.

AUS.note: Beef/sheep offal exporter. 2024 flows to Indonesia 45, USA 24, Japan 23, Korea 17. Export ~140 kt modeled from observed flows; by-product of Australia's beef slaughter.

FRA.note: EU offal exporter and intra-EU trader. 2024 flows to China 76, Philippines 20, Belgium 18, Cote d'Ivoire 17; also imports from Spain 31, UK 27. Export ~190 kt modeled from observed flows.

HKG.note: Major entrepot/import market re-exporting offal to mainland China. UN Comtrade 2024 imports 265 kt (HS0206) — Brazil 153, Argentina 21, Australia 14. Demand driven by Chinese cuisine organ-meat consumption.

MEX.note: Large offal IMPORT market (pork/beef offal for processing). FAOSTAT 2024: imports led by USA 226, Canada 43. Mexico reports value-only in Comtrade; import volume modeled from partner-reported flows (~300 kt). Net importer.

PHL.note: Major offal IMPORT market. FAOSTAT 2024: imports led by Spain 108, USA 39, Netherlands 30, Canada 24, Brazil 21, France 20 (~280 kt). Strong demand for poultry/pork offal; structural net importer.

JPN.note: Established offal import market (beef/pork tongue, liver, etc.). FAOSTAT 2024 imports led by USA 53, Australia 23 (~150 kt total). Net importer.

EGY.note: North African offal import market (bovine liver/offal). FAOSTAT 2024 imports led by USA 94, Brazil 18, India 17 (~140 kt). Net importer; price-sensitive bulk buyer.

CIV.note: West African offal import market. FAOSTAT 2024 imports led by Brazil 42, Poland 30, Germany 23, France 17 (~120 kt). Low-cost poultry/pork offal a key protein source; net importer.

rankings.note: Exporters: UN Comtrade/FAOSTAT 2024 world export volumes (HS0206); USA #1 (736 kt observed), then EU pork-offal exporters and Brazil. Importers: China dominates at ~1.19 Mt (Comtrade China-reported), far ahead of Mexico/Philippines/Hong Kong. Mid-table importer figures (USA, Belgium, Netherlands re-imports) are modeled from partner-reported flows.

companies.name: JBS
companies.note: World's largest meat company; beef/pork/poultry offal (livers, tongues, tripe, hearts) is a high-value side-stream of its carcass business, exported to China, Hong Kong and West Africa.
companies.improve: Should isolate offal/variety-meat revenue from primary carcass meat and add destination split; sourcing share is an estimate.

companies.name: Tyson Foods
companies.note: Top US beef/pork/poultry processor; exports variety meats (offal) to China, Mexico, Japan as a by-product of its slaughter operations.
companies.improve: Should quantify variety-meat export volume separately from primary cuts.

companies.name: Smithfield Foods (WH Group)
companies.note: Largest US pork producer, owned by China's WH Group — a natural channel for US pork offal into the Chinese market (China is the #1 offal importer).
companies.improve: Should confirm the pork-offal share of WH Group's US-to-China export volume.

companies.name: Danish Crown
companies.note: Europe's largest pork processor and exporter; pig offal is a recovered by-product shipped notably to China (DNK->CHN 116 kt).
companies.improve: Should separate offal tonnage from primary pork exports.

companies.name: BRF
companies.note: Major Brazilian poultry/pork processor; poultry and pork offal is a side-stream exported to Hong Kong, the Middle East and West Africa.
companies.improve: Should add offal-specific volume and split poultry vs pork offal.

companies.name: Vion Food Group
companies.note: Large Dutch/German beef and pork processor; offal is recovered and traded through the Netherlands EU hub and exported to China and the Philippines.
companies.improve: Should quantify the offal share of throughput and confirm China/Philippines volumes.

global.note: World edible offal (HS0206) is a by-product of cattle/pig/sheep/goat/poultry slaughter, so 'production' is modeled to track global meat slaughter (~19 Mt offal-equivalent in 2024, OECD-FAO/FAOSTAT meat balances). Internationally traded volume ~3.9-4.0 Mt in 2024 (UN Comtrade HS0206); China alone takes ~1.19 Mt of imports. Trade has grown steadily with Chinese organ-meat demand.

forecast.method: OECD-FAO meat-output envelope applied to offal (slaughter by-product); 2030=2024×(1+rate)^6
